subject: Urgent: ClearBank p95 latency variance — model_swarm v3.2 pin/quarantine request
thread_content:
--- Message 1/4 ---
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@clearbank.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: p95 latency spike model_swarm v3.2 — affecting payments API

Naomi,

We started seeing a sustained p95 jump on model_swarm v3.2 for the payments/authorization route around 07:45 UTC. 
Key numbers: p50 ~55ms (unchanged), p95 spiked from ~220ms to ~820ms over ~20 minutes. Error rates unchanged (~0.02%), but latency is causing timeouts in our client-side batching.

Attached is a short error sample and a dashboard snapshot. This is impacting our production payment flows for EU customers. Can Redwood immediately pin traffic off v3.2 (traffic quarantine) and fall back to v3.1 while you investigate? We need confirmation and ETA.

Attachments: clearbank-error-sample.json, slo-dashboard-snapshot.png

— Amit
Amit Shah
ClearBank — Platform Ops
ops@clearbank.com

--- Message 2/4 ---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@clearbank.com>, ClearBank Ops <ops@clearbank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 09:05:12 -0400
Subject: Re: p95 latency spike model_swarm v3.2 — affecting payments API

Amit — thanks for the quick signal and attached data. We see the same spike in our EU canary metrics. Preliminary triage shows increased per-token execution time for v3.2 at sequence lengths >512; models with the new attention kernel show CPU/GPU kernel fallbacks under certain packing patterns.

Immediate proposal (mitigation plan):
- Quarantine: stop routing new traffic to model_swarm v3.2 on ClearBank's route (safely drain in-flight requests).
- Pinlift/fallback: route ClearBank traffic to model_swarm v3.1 for 30 minutes while we push a targeted investigation; if stable, keep pin for up to 2 hours while we collect traces.
- Observability: we will capture full p95/p99 distributions, kernel-level traces and a KV-cache hit-rate snapshot.

Requesting explicit authorization to perform the quarantine + pin (this will temporarily change ClearBank's model variant mapping and may trigger a provisional SLA carveout). Please confirm you approve the switch; Marcus/Monica — requesting engineering + CS sign-off to proceed immediately if ClearBank approves.

Related links: https://redwood.internal/d/CB-4231/slo (dashboard), JIRA-INF-7823
Attachments: slo-dashboard-snapshot.png

Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

--- Message 3/4 ---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@clearbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 10:02:47 -0400
Subject: Re: p95 latency spike model_swarm v3.2 — affecting payments API

On Tue, Jun 27, 2028 at 09:05 Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Amit — thanks for the quick signal and attached data. We see the same spike in our EU canary metrics.
> Immediate proposal (mitigation plan):
> - Quarantine: stop routing new traffic to model_swarm v3.2 on ClearBank's route (safely drain in-flight requests).
> - Pinlift/fallback: route ClearBank traffic to model_swarm v3.1 for 30 minutes while we investigate; extend to 2 hours if needed.

Approved. Marcus (engineering infra) authorizes immediate quarantine and pin to model_swarm v3.1 for ClearBank's account for an initial 30-minute window. If after 30 mins the p95 is within normal bounds we can extend up to 2 hours while collecting traces.

Operational notes for Infra (for whoever executes):
1) Apply routing override for account CB-4231 in the SmartRouter (policy id: SR-0895).
2) Drain all in-flight sessions to v3.2; mark v3.2 variant as quarantined for route cb/payments.
3) Push traffic to v3.1 with sticky sessions off, monitor p95/p99 and GPU kernel fallbacks.
4) If p95 remains > 400ms after 30 mins, escalate to runtime team (pager).

Authorization reference: AUTH-CRB-0062
Marcus Lin
Director, Runtime Engineering
marcus_lin@redwood.com

--- Message 4/4 ---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@clearbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 16:43:05 -0400
Subject: Re: p95 latency spike model_swarm v3.2 — affecting payments API (update)

Amit / team — follow-up and closeout notes.
- We executed the quarantine and pin to model_swarm v3.1 at 09:20 UTC on 2028-06-27 per AUTH-CRB-0062.
- Observed result: ClearBank p95 returned to pre-spike levels (~210ms) within 7 minutes of the pin. p99 and error rates stable.
- Root-cause: runtime kernel fallback on sequences >512 in v3.2 under certain packing patterns; infra traces and model runtime team are preparing a patch for the attention kernel.
- Current status: v3.2 remains quarantined for ClearBank route; we will coordinate a targeted patch rollout to a canary of non-critical routes only after validation.

Please log this as an incident (JIRA-INF-7823) and let me know if you need a formal SLA concession letter. We did not extend a provisional carveout beyond the initial authorized window.

Thanks — will keep you posted when a fixed variant is safe to resume traffic.

Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
